description.content:
Insights is a feature that provides an overview of network experience across the entire site, access points, or clients.

It offers useful information about current conditions, such as telemetry data from wired switches, edge devices, wireless clients, access points, network applications, and bluetooth low energy (ble) tags.

These insights can be used to correct issues, make changes, and ensure a good network experience for users.
Get Site Insight Metrics

query.description: (Required) Comma separated Metric names, e.g. `num_clients,num_aps`. See possible values at [List Insight Metrics](/#operations/listInsightMetrics)
Start time (epoch timestamp in seconds, or relative string like "-1d", "-1w")
End time (epoch timestamp in seconds, or relative string like "-1d", "-2h", "now")
Duration like 7d, 2w
Aggregation works by giving a time range plus interval (e.g. 1d, 1h, 10m) where aggregation function would be applied to.
